name: Bots Exposed
author: Fulfillment.Global

sections.description:
This plugin blocks IP addresses based on disallowed URL requests in robots.txt or in a custom list.

A daily report of blocked IP addresses is sent to the site’s default Administration Email Address, if the appropriate setting is activated.

Third party service description

This plugin does not make use of any third party services. No data is collected or submitted by this plugin.

This plugin’s source code may be verified for confirmation.

Usage

Install and activate the plugin.

To undo the IP blocking of this plugin, simply deactivate or uninstall the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, this plugin is free to use. The source code is available for you to examine what the plugin does and how it works.
